title: Neon Pinball
author: cobanov
description: A glowing pinball table made for the handheld: L and R are the flippers. Light the lanes, spin the spinner and clear both target banks for multiball.

controls.R / A: Right flipper (A also selects in menus and plays again)
controls.DOWN: Hold to pull the plunger, release to launch; choose in menus
controls.UP: Nudge the table (too much tilts it); choose in menus
controls.B: Resume (pause menu); back to title (game over)
